blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: These delicious prenatal multivitamins are the perfect way to ensure you get the vitamins you need to help keep you healthy during pregnancy. Each Multivitamin is packed with essential vitamins and minerals such as Vitamins A, B, C, D, E, Zinc and more!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take two (2) gummies per day. Chew thoroughly before swallowing.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Glucose syrup, sugar, water, pectin, natural flavor, black carrot concentrate and sodium copper chlorophyllin (colors), trisodium citrate, citric acid, carnauba wax.
Does not contain eggs, wheat (gluten), milk, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy or shellfish.
Processed in a nut free facility.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed suggested serving size. If you have a medical condition, are taking medication, or are pregnant or nursing, ask a doctor before using. Not for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.

Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose call a doctor or poison control center immediately.
Do not use this product if safety seat under cap is torn or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
